business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Item 1 business description
business_model.claim: LifeStance sells outpatient mental healthcare delivered by its employed clinicians, in person or virtually, and earns revenue each time a patient is seen.
quotes: We generate revenue on a per-visit basis when a patient receives care from one of our clinicians.

business_model.claim: Most revenue comes from commercial insurers' in-network coverage of patients. The latest annual report splits revenue as 90% commercial in-network, 5% government, 4% self-pay and 1% non-patient services.
quotes: For the year ended December 31, 2025, 90% of our revenue was derived from patients with commercial in-network payors, 5% of our revenue was derived from patients with government payors, 4% of our revenue was derived from patients on a self-pay basis and 1% of our revenue was derived from non-patient services.

business_model.claim: Payment is typically fee-for-service at negotiated reimbursement rates. For supported practices that the company does not own, revenue is management fees under long-term management services contracts.
quotes: Our contracts with payors are typically structured as fee-for-service arrangements, with negotiated reimbursement rates for our clinical services.
With respect to our supported practices, our revenue is derived from management fees negotiated under our management services contracts.

business_model.claim: Revenue is concentrated in two payors. UnitedHealthcare and Elevance Health each exceeded 10% of total revenue, at 14% and 15% respectively, in the latest annual report.
quotes: Two payors individually exceeded 10% of our total revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025: UnitedHealthcare and Elevance Health, Inc., comprising 14% and 15% of our total revenue, respectively.
